name: [⭐RELEASE] Anime Revengers
desc:
🎮 Welcome to Anime Revengers!

🌌 Dive into a world inspired by iconic anime universes and become stronger with every battle!
⚔️ Defeat powerful enemies to earn unique swords and fuse them to unlock higher rarities and stronger abilities!
✨ Discover new forms, effects, and evolving weapons as you progress through challenging worlds.
👥 Team up with friends to conquer raids, defeat bosses, and complete missions together!
🎁 Rewards are shared across all modes, so every fight counts toward your progression.
📱 Play anytime on PC, Mobile, Tablet, and Console!

⭐ Developed By Nexora Studios!
